ideas.pitch: A voice-first desktop application that intercepts fraudulent phone calls in real-time and warns seniors using local LLM inference.
ideas.problem_statement: Preventing financial fraud targeting vulnerable demographics using real-time audio analysis.
ideas.title: ElderGuard AI Voice Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies winning architecture from the GOSIM Agentic Hackathon, focusing on localized privacy and a voice-first interface that judges can test live.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed accident detection network utilizing mobile sensors and C++ processing to dispatch precise incident coordinates to emergency services.
ideas.problem_statement: Reducing critical delays in post-accident emergency response and location telemetry.
ideas.title: AutoSOS Crash Response System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a proven first-place IoT hackathon winner by focusing on hardware-software integration that solves an urgent life-safety problem.

ideas.pitch: A predictive web mapping platform that estimates localized water contamination risks days in advance using lightweight environmental telemetry.
ideas.problem_statement: Monitoring and forecasting aquatic ecosystem health hazards to protect local fisheries and public safety.
ideas.title: AquaSense Coastal Algal Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning strategy of the AquaSense IoT Hackathon by turning complex environmental data into an intuitive, actionable web dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An Android application that uses device cameras and computer vision pose estimation to guide patients through accurate physical rehabilitation movements.
ideas.problem_statement: Automating physical therapy form correction and progress tracking outside clinical settings.
ideas.title: FitPose Physical Therapy Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the exact winning pattern from Hack4Soc, executing a robust mobile-first machine learning model that provides immediate visual feedback.

ideas.pitch: An automated financial monitoring platform that utilizes graph intelligence and explainable gradient boosting to detect complex money laundering patterns.
ideas.problem_statement: Detecting sophisticated, multi-hop financial fraud rings in real-time transaction streams.
ideas.title: GraphAML Transaction Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural blueprint of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner, offering transparent, explainable AI that appeals heavily to financial judges.
